captionBasis: This form has no fillable field. Every box below is a measured TABLE CELL: four strokes read out of the page's own content stream — the rule above, the rule below and the vertical divider on each side — and every one of them is re-checked against the pinned binary on each build. A divider must span the cell it bounds, so a divider from a different band cannot stand in for a missing one. The caption is whatever the form prints inside the cell, recorded verbatim at its own coordinates in printedTextInThisCell.
